classification.rationale: Heading 4202 covers handbags whether or not with shoulder strap. Under GRI 1 and GRI 6, a bag with an outer surface of leather falls in 4202.21; the lining material is irrelevant to the outer-surface test. Not reptile, and valued over $20 each, so 4202.21.90.00. In-force ruling N005126 classified a leather-surfaced handbag with one shoulder strap, zipper and textile lining in 4202.21.9000 as valued over $20 each. Code validated as a current 10-digit leaf.
